zones.title: Reservation, services, fulfilments
zones.body: API V2 order: POST reservations for the session's vehicle at the agreed dealer, then GET services and GET fulfilments for it. A dealer without online booking answers with no reservation and the callback or self-service note.

zones.title: Store and return
zones.body: Reservation, dealer, services and fulfilments are stored on the session; selected services and offered slots are reset.

panels.title: AR-19 CreateReservation
panels.body: DealerBook API V2 order (endpoint sheet, 2026-10-23): POST reservations, GET services, GET fulfilments; the selections follow as PATCHes in FindSlots and BookAppointment. A dealer without online booking answers with no reservation and the note to offer a retailer callback or self-service.
